title: Next 30 years a danger time in the Taurid stream
summary: Graham Hancock tells of Next 30 years a danger time in the Taurid stream, about 2020s-2050s at Earth orbit / Taurid meteor stream, and relays what a named person told them. As told, not a fact.

tellings.quote: scientists from the comet research group he points that out that the next 30 years are a danger time

plain: Graham Hancock, an author who writes about lost ancient civilisations, passes on a warning from Allen West and the Comet Research Group, a team of scientists who study ancient comet impacts. He says they believe the next 30 years will be a dangerous time as Earth passes through the Taurid stream, a band of comet debris the planet crosses every year. If true, a major impact like those they think struck in the past could happen again soon.
